evidence.name: Screen field: Pick the font
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Pick the font" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Pick the font
sections.description: Sets which typeface this text uses. By default it follows your theme font, which keeps the whole funnel looking consistent, so change it only for a deliberate accent. Stick to one or two fonts across the funnel so it reads as polished and on-brand to paid visitors.
